articles.title: Man charged with attempted rape in Rochdale parks
articles.excerpt: A man in his 20s has been arrested on suspicion of attempted rape after two separate incidents in Rochdale parks this morning.
articles.content_html:
A man has been arrested in connection with two sex attacks in Rochdale. The man, in his 20s, has been held on suspicion of attempted rape following incidents that occurred less than two hours apart on Saturday, July 25.

The first incident took place in Broadfield Park at around 6:15am, where a woman reported being sexually assaulted by a stranger. The second incident occurred in Milnrow Memorial Park, reported at 8:38am, where another woman also claimed she had been attacked by an unknown man.

Greater Manchester Police (GMP) stated that both women provided similar descriptions of the suspect, who is described as a black male believed to have been wearing a three-piece suit or smart black clothing and a dark coat. He was also reported to have been carrying a briefcase. Police confirmed that a robust investigation is underway, and CCTV enquiries indicated a suspect leaving the Coco Lounge in Rochdale town centre at 5am.

In an update issued later, GMP confirmed the arrest of the man on suspicion of two counts of attempted rape. He remains in custody for questioning as enquiries continue. The victims are being supported by specialist officers during this time. Anyone with information is urged to contact GMP on 101, quoting incident numbers 79 and 880 of 25/07/2026, or to reach out to Crimestoppers anonymously.

articles.content_html:
Police are investigating two sexual assaults that occurred in Rochdale, which they believe may be connected. The incidents took place recently, prompting detectives to examine the circumstances surrounding both cases.

Authorities have not released specific details about the victims or the locations of the assaults, but they are urging anyone with information to come forward.

The police are actively pursuing leads and gathering evidence to determine the nature of the connection between the two incidents. Further updates are expected as the investigation progresses.

Anyone with information can find Greater Manchester Police and Crimestoppers contact details at the end of this article.
